title: Beyond Fixed Acquisition Functions: Temporal Difference Active Learning for Perturbation Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.22122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training signal for learning how to select experiments. We formulate budgeted perturbation discovery as a sequential decision problem and propose Temporal Difference Active Learning (TDAL), which learns an acquisition function online through temporal difference learning from a single screening trajectory, accounting for current hits and future discoveries. translated_title: 超越固定采集函数：面向扰动发现的时间差分主动学习
translated_abstract: 基因与药物扰动筛选是阐明疾病机制和验证治疗靶点的重要工具，但实验成本限制了可测试的候选对象数量。现有的扰动筛选方法通常在利用反馈更新代理模型的同时保持采集函数固定，这限制了它们针对不同响应景观自适应调整选择策略的能力。实验反馈能够揭示当前的命中结果，并通过更新候选预测来指导后续的选择，从而为学习如何选择实验提供了训练信号。我们将预算约束下的扰动发现表述为一个序贯决策问题，并提出时间差分主动学习（TDAL），该方法通过时间差分学习从单次筛选轨迹中在线学习采集函数，同时兼顾当前的命中结果与未来的潜在发现。TDAL利用命中概率分布之间的Hellinger距离……
tldr: 提出了一种名为TDAL的主动学习方法，将预算约束下的扰动发现建模为序贯决策问题，通过时间差分学习从单次筛选轨迹中在线学习采集函数，突破传统固定采集函数的局限，实现自适应的实验选择。
en_tdlr: Proposes TDAL, an active learning method that formulates budgeted perturbation discovery as a sequential decision problem and learns acquisition functions online via temporal difference learning from a single screening trajectory, overcoming the limitations of fixed acquisition functions.
